fullPassage: Everything in the world exists on a continuum, whether in speed, size, or any other possible descriptor you could think of. Still, we create and mindlessly adopt sharp distinctions, and those distinctions change lives far more dramatically than marginal differences ever do. Indeed, all differences are arbitrary, but drawing hard lines between categories hides this arbitrariness and can be severely damaging. I call this resulting damage "the borderline effect." The examples are endless. Someone's IQ is 69 and someone else's is 70 — but only the score of 70 is deemed to be within the range of normal. We don't have to be statisticians to know there is not a meaningful difference between 69 and 70. Yet once the person with the lower score is labeled "cognitively impaired," his or her life will unfold differently than the person with a one-point advantage.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 우리는 뚜렷한 구분을 '무심코' 채택한다 → 부사 mindlessly
det.analysis: __________ adopt → 동사(adopt)를 수식하는 부사 자리. mind(명사/동사) → mindlessly(부사)로 변환. mind → mindless(형용사) → mindlessly(부사).
det.tip: mind(마음, 동사: 꺼리다) → mindless(무심한) → mindlessly(무심코, 아무 생각 없이)

questions.passage: We don't have to be statisticians to know there is not a __________ (mean) difference between 69 and 70.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 69와 70 사이에 '의미 있는' 차이가 없다 → 형용사 meaningful
det.analysis: a __________ difference → 명사(difference)를 수식하는 형용사 자리. mean(동사/형용사) → meaningful(형용사)로 변환.
det.tip: mean(의미하다) → meaningful(의미 있는, 형용사). meaningful difference = 의미 있는 차이

questions.passage: Everything in the world exists on a continuum, whether in speed, size, or any other possible descriptor you could think of. Still, we create and mindlessly adopt sharp distinctions, and those distinctions change lives far more dramatically than marginal differences ever do. Indeed, all differences are arbitrary, but drawing hard lines between categories hides this arbitrariness and can be severely damaging. I call this resulting damage "__________." The examples are endless. Someone's IQ is 69 and someone else's is 70 — but only the score of 70 is deemed to be within the range of normal. We don't have to be statisticians to know there is not a meaningful difference between 69 and 70. Yet once the person with the lower score is labeled "cognitively impaired," his or her life will unfold differently than the person with a one-point advantage.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 나는 이 결과적 피해를 '경계선 효과'라고 부른다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① the meaningful difference — 의미 있는 차이 (뒤에서 사용되나 damage의 명칭으로 부적합)
✅ ② the borderline effect — 경계선 효과. I call this resulting damage '___' ←정답
❌ ③ the normal range — 정상 범위 (뒤에서 사용되나 damage의 명칭으로 부적합)
❌ ④ the sharp distinction — 뚜렷한 구분 (damage의 명칭이 아님)
det.tip: the borderline effect = 경계선 효과. 필자가 만든 개념으로, 경계선에서 발생하는 피해를 지칭

questions.passage: Everything in the world exists on a continuum, whether in speed, size, or any other possible descriptor you could think of. Still, we create and mindlessly adopt sharp distinctions, and those distinctions change lives far more dramatically than marginal differences ever do. Indeed, all differences are arbitrary, but __________ hides this arbitrariness and can be severely damaging. I call this resulting damage "the borderline effect." The examples are endless. Someone's IQ is 69 and someone else's is 70 — but only the score of 70 is deemed to be within the range of normal. We don't have to be statisticians to know there is not a meaningful difference between 69 and 70. Yet once the person with the lower score is labeled "cognitively impaired," his or her life will unfold differently than the person with a one-point advantage.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 모든 차이는 임의적이지만, '범주 사이에 확고한 선을 긋는 것'이 이 임의성을 숨기고 심각한 피해를 줄 수 있다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① creating sharp distinctions mindlessly — 뚜렷한 구분을 무심코 만들기 (앞 문장 내용이지 빈칸 자리 표현 아님)
❌ ② being labeled cognitively impaired — 인지장애 꼬리표가 붙는 것 (뒤 문단 내용)
✅ ③ drawing hard lines between categories — 범주 사이에 확고한 선을 긋기. 원문 정확 일치 ←정답
❌ ④ knowing the meaningful difference — 의미 있는 차이를 아는 것 (뒤 문단 내용이며 hides와 논리 불일치)
det.tip: drawing hard lines between categories = 범주 사이에 확고한 선을 긋기. draw a line = 선을 긋다
